outcome: glycemic control (Time in Range, Time Above Range, Time Below Target)
infant neonatal intensive care unit admissions
cohort: The study included 25 pregnant women with Type 1 Diabetes from three U.S. sites, who enrolled before 17 weeks gestation and used personal insulin pumps and study continuous glucose monitors.
finding: While insulin dosing significantly increased with advancing gestation, most participants did not achieve the recommended >70% Time in Range (TIR) for pregnancy, with TIR being significantly lower between 18 and 30 weeks.
gest_age: Participants enrolled before 17 weeks gestation, and data were analyzed from early pregnancy through 40 weeks gestation.
